reason: Close the residual packaged Windows activation deadline defect exposed by PR #615 Product Final run 32615334130, Windows job 97135022629. The real packaged Yance.exe remains alive for the external 120-second observation window but never emits post-install-launch.json. Fresh source-graph audit proves the previously merged #684 repair removed the activation controller's explicit timeoutMs argument while electron/main.js waitForBackendReadyForActivation still installs its own default 60000ms setTimeout. That adapter deadline can expire before the existing backend lifecycle authority completes asynchronous Windows owner identity and trusted READY/session establishment, preventing sendActivation and therefore the real post-install PASS receipt. This work package is failure-first, preserves Product Final and the existing lifecycle/readiness authorities, and forbids timeout inflation or a second readiness authority.
